title: ReviewFinding
description: A single finding emitted by a reviewer skill during phase-4c-reviewer-dispatch. Validated by orchestrator before aggregation in phase-4f. GUARDRAIL: proposed_plan field forbidden.

finding_id.description: Unique finding identifier. Format: RVW-{REVIEWER_CODE}-{seq}. Reviewer codes: ARCH (architecture), SEC (security), PERF (performance), MAINT (maintainability). Examples: RVW-ARCH-0001, RVW-SEC-0042, RVW-PERF-0007, RVW-MAINT-0003.

issue_fingerprint.description: sha256(title + '|' + section_id + '|' + reviewer_type) truncated to first 16 hex chars. Computed by orchestrator during aggregation (phase-4f) if absent. Used for deduplication: keep highest-severity instance when same fingerprint appears from multiple reviewers. Also used by phase-4e contradiction detection: fingerprint with severity_group divergence across reviewers triggers scoped debate.

reviewer_type.description: Which reviewer skill produced this finding. Must match the emitting skill: architecture-reviewer → 'architecture', security-reviewer → 'security', performance-reviewer → 'performance', maintainability-reviewer → 'maintainability'.

section_id.description: The plan section this finding targets. Must match a section_id in the plan under review. No casing constraint — matches whatever format the planner uses for section IDs.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the finding. Used in issue_fingerprint computation.

severity.description: Severity level. critical = must fix before any code generation; high = must fix this sprint; medium = technical debt; low = advisory; info = informational only.

category.description: Finding category. Each reviewer uses its own taxonomy subset: architecture uses interface_gap/dependency_violation/coupling/scalability/resilience/req_coverage/pattern_violation/rollback_gap; security uses authentication/authorization/injection/secrets_exposure/crypto_weakness/input_validation/owasp_top10/compliance_gap/data_exposure; performance uses missing_slo/n_plus_one/missing_index/missing_cache/scalability_gap/sync_hot_path/missing_perf_test/resource_bounds_missing; maintainability uses missing_test/missing_rollback/missing_observability/missing_docs/solid_violation/tech_debt/missing_runbook/api_versioning_gap. 'other' is the fallback for edge cases.

description.description: Full description of the problem, including root cause where known.

recommendation.description: Specific actionable recommendation to resolve the finding. MUST NOT be a plan or plan revision — describes what should change, not a replacement plan.

evidence.description: Typed supporting evidence for the finding.

source_ref.description: Reference to the exact plan section, task ID, module name, or line in a spec file.

code_snippet.description: Optional verbatim excerpt from the plan or spec illustrating the problem.

cwe_id.description: Optional CWE reference for security findings.

requires_debate.description: Set true by aggregator (phase-4f) when this finding participates in a contradiction pair across reviewers. When true, the section is added to phase-4e debate trigger list.

contradiction_pair_fingerprint.description: Present only when requires_debate=true. The issue_fingerprint of the contradicting finding from the opposing reviewer (same fingerprint, diverging severity group: one critical/high, other low/info).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the finding was created by the reviewer skill.

resolved_by_change_request.description: Optional. Change request ID that resolves this finding. Set during phase-4g or change-request-handler. Pattern matches CR ID format: CR-{8-hex}-{3-digit-seq}.
